heroSummary: Minneapolis Public Schools grades 1–12 began Tuesday, September 2, 2025; Pre-K and kindergarten began Thursday, September 4. Grades 10–12 were directed to check their school for a later first-day start during freshman orientation. MEA Break was October 16–17, Winter Break was December 22–January 2, Spring Break was March 30–April 3, and the last day was June 10, 2026.
calendarNotes: The earliest firstDay field is September 2 for grades 1–12, while Pre-K and kindergarten begin September 4. Grades 10–12 should use their school's first-day arrival instructions because of freshman orientation. The calendar contains 168 instructional days. October's family-teacher conference and two-day MEA Break create three consecutive non-school weekdays. MPS prints Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha as non-school days in this school year. Record-keeping and professional-development days are separate from seasonal breaks. The 2025–26 page is based on a locally reviewed MPS original PDF because no stable official PDF URL was supplied; the official calendar hub remains the public verification page.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Minneapolis Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 began Tuesday, September 2, 2025. Pre-K and kindergarten began Thursday, September 4. Grades 10–12 were told to check their high school for a possible late first-day start.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MPS MEA Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: MEA Break was October 16–17, 2025. The family-teacher conference day immediately before it, October 15, was also a non-school day.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 30, through Friday, April 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Which religious holidays closed MPS in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists Rosh Hashanah on September 23, Yom Kippur on October 2, Eid al-Fitr on March 20, and Eid al-Adha on May 27 as non-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of Minneapolis Public Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of the regular MPS school year was Wednesday, June 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is there no 2025–26 MPS PDF download link here?
calendarFaqs.a: The dates were verified from a local official MPS original PDF, but no stable official PDF URL was supplied. MySchoolDates does not publish an unrelated third-party URL or fabricate a district download link.

The page was rendered visually because circled first/last days and shaded non-school dates are structural information that plain-text extraction can flatten.
